main_body: Wooden barrel with grey iron hoops, water visible in the open top, standing on the ground
top_band: Brown back rim at row 3, then dark blue water rows 4-5 and bright blue water rows 6-7, closed by a light front-rim/hoop row at row 8 (L 170-215). The top is the whole ellipse, rows 3-8.
evidence: The column scan shows brown rim, then 4 rows of blue water seen from above, then a light 1-row front lip at row 8. Below it a darker staved front face (rows 9-15, L 70-117) carries grey hoops at rows 10 and 13. This matches the green guide barrel with an ellipse top: a visible water opening, a front edge line, and a darker shaded row under the lip. The front face has no recessed doors, but a barrel does not need them. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The candidate has 14 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Its median of 14 per tile is near the references' 17-20, but the palette is clearly thinner. 89% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 1% and 33% in the references. The black vertical edge strips beside the hoops read as a neutral black sticker outline, not a dark tone of the adjacent wood. Wood has only about 3 tones, the water 2-3, and the hoops 2. There are no flat 5x5 fills, but the grain and per-stave variation are modest. The outline is the main weakness, so it falls below the Beodeul standard.
